issues.explanation: Chapter 22 ends with Liu Bei and Zhang Fei stationed at Xiaopei, but Chapter 23 later states without any transition that Liu Bei and Ma Teng had departed, causing Dong Cheng’s plan to fail. The adaptation does not explain when or why Liu Bei left, creating a noticeable cross-chapter timeline gap.
issues.suggested_fix: Add a brief bridge stating that, after the events at Xiaopei, Liu Bei and Ma Teng had separately departed, or rephrase the later summary to make clear this occurred during an omitted intervening period.
